name: Fast footage plus kinetic captions
description: Repackage existing footage into a clear vertical ad. Builds an editable 15-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: Existing footage already shows the product or benefit clearly.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 15 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: Your strongest result shot opens the ad and comes back at the end.

props.text: A still of your best result. It comes back as the end card.

props.label: Hook
props.hint: Shows with the hero shot at the start.

props.subtitle: Each benefit gets its own shot and caption. They switch together.
The hero shot becomes an end card with the offer.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

value.title: Fast footage plus kinetic captions
value.objective: Repackage existing footage into a clear vertical ad.
value.direction: Each shot has one message; cuts and typography create speed without making the image unreadable.
beats: 0–1.5 s: Strongest result shot appears immediately with one hook. Shows Brand color, Hero shot, Hook.
1.5–5 s: Two related shots show the first reason to care. Shows Brand color, Benefit shot 1, Benefit 1.
5–8.5 s: Switch scene and caption together. Shows Brand color, Benefit shot 2, Benefit 2.
8.5–12 s: Use the clearest proof/result footage. Shows Brand color, Benefit shot 3, Benefit 3.
12–15 s: Cleanest hero shot becomes an end card. Shows Brand color, Hero shot, Logo, Call to action and offer.

images.label: Hero shot
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Strongest result shot appears immediately with one hook. | Cleanest hero shot becomes an end card.

images.label: Benefit shot 1
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Two related shots show the first reason to care.

images.label: Benefit shot 2
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Switch scene and caption together.

images.label: Benefit shot 3
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Use the clearest proof/result footage.

images.label: Logo
images.guidance: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: Cleanest hero shot becomes an end card.
